text.aria-label: Title text 'CRPS rises with the lead; the S1 family and BG2 sit close together, well below manual_heuristic and climatology Mean CRPS over clean half-hours of 4 test months (2025-10, 2026-01, 2026-03, 2026-06), real data, 1.15 widening of the S1 family, 5 seeds.
